_doc: Delivery jobs. from/to are cabin ids from world.json ('depot' = the trailhead spawn). carry: 'rack' (on the sled, adds to its mass) or 'trailer' (needs a tow hitch). timeLimit in seconds; pay is the base for full-health, on-time delivery. Fragile cargo loses value on hard landings; lost items aren't paid; late deliveries pay latePay × base. Time bonus = seconds early × timeBonusPerSecond, capped at timeBonusCap × base pay.

jobs.name: Medical Run
jobs.brief: Two cases of medical supplies for the family at Pine Hollow. Fragile – take the jumps easy.

jobs.name: Parcel Post
jobs.brief: Mail run to the south camp. Light and quick, but the parcels don't like rough handling.

jobs.name: Fuel to the Ridge
jobs.brief: Four jerry cans up to the ridge hut. Heavy on the hitch and the climb is long.

jobs.name: Firewood Haul
jobs.brief: A full trailer of firewood across the valley. Mind the side slopes – it's top-heavy.

jobs.name: Lakeside Resupply
jobs.brief: Mixed load with fragile medical and parcels. The short way is across the ice…

jobs.name: Express Medical
jobs.brief: Urgent supplies, end to end of the valley. Every second counts and the box must arrive intact.
